name: posting
description: A job posting on a hiring platform. The platform + posting_id pair identifies it (e.g. id posting_saramin_10000001).

platform.description: Hiring platform the posting is listed on.

posting_id.description: The platform's own posting number, as a string, e.g. '10000001'.

company_id.description: Entity id of the hiring company (a company entity), e.g. 'co_gasangtech'.

title.description: Posting title as shown on the platform.

location.description: Actual work location (city/district), e.g. '서울 강남구'. Prefer the real workplace over the listed one when they differ.

deadline.description: Application deadline, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Absent when the posting is open until filled.
